Tostada integral con AOVE y tomate.t: Whole wheat toast with EVOO and tomato
Tostada integral con AOVE y tomate.s: Grate the tomatoes on the cut side and let the excess water drain in a strainer for 5 minutes. Toast the bread until golden brown and rub each slice with the cracked garlic clove. Spread the grated tomato, season with salt and finish with a good splash of olive oil just before serving.

Smoothie detox con espinaca y piña.t: Detox smoothie with spinach and pineapple
Smoothie detox con espinaca y piña.s: Wash the spinach well and peel and chop the pineapple and ginger. Put everything in the blender with the yogurt, cold water and lemon juice and blend for 1 minute at maximum power until there are no pieces left. Serve immediately, very cold, to take advantage of all the vitamins.

Tortilla de patatas.s: Peel and cut the potatoes into thin slices and the onion into julienne strips. Confit them in the oil over medium-low heat for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally, until they are tender but not browning; drain them well. Beat the eggs with salt, mix with the potatoes and let sit for 10 minutes. Set the tortilla in a small frying pan with a tablespoon of the oil for 3 minutes, turn it over with a plate and set for another 2-3 minutes depending on how juicy you want it.

Paella de verduras.s: Sauté the pepper, zucchini, quartered artichokes and beans in the paella with the oil for 8 minutes. Add the chopped garlic, grated tomato and paprika and cook for 2 more minutes. Add the rice, give it a stir, pour in the hot broth with the saffron and distribute well. Cook for 10 minutes over high heat and 8 over low heat without stirring. Turn off, cover with a cloth and let it rest for 5 minutes before serving.

Lentejas con chorizo.s: Put the lentils in a pot (they do not need to be soaked) with the cold water, the chopped onion and pepper, the sliced carrot, the whole garlic, the bay leaf and the thickly sliced chorizo. Bring to a boil, foam, and cook over low heat for 30 minutes. Add the diced potato and the paprika dissolved in the oil and cook for 20 more minutes until everything is tender. Adjust the salt and let it rest for 10 minutes: they are even better from one day to the next.

Pescado al horno con pimientos.s: Preheat the oven to 200°C. Cut the potato into thin slices, the peppers into strips and the onion into julienne strips, season with half the oil and salt and bake for 20 minutes as a bed. Place the seasoned fillets on top, sprinkle with the wine, the rest of the oil and a few lemon slices and bake for 12-15 more minutes, until the fish separates into flakes. Sprinkle chopped parsley when serving.

Pollo al ajillo con patatas.s: Cut the chicken into pieces, season with salt and pepper and brown it in a large frying pan with the oil over high heat for 8 minutes. Add the whole crushed garlic and diced potatoes and sauté for 5 minutes. Pour in the wine, add the rosemary, cover and cook over medium heat for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the chicken is cooked through and the potatoes are tender. Raise the heat at the end so that everything is golden.

Bowl de avena y frutos rojos.t: Bowl of oats and red fruits
Bowl de avena y frutos rojos.s: Cook the oat flakes with the vegetable milk over low heat for 5-7 minutes, stirring, until a thick cream is obtained. Divide into two bowls and top with red berries, chopped walnuts, a drizzle of honey and cinnamon. In summer you can soak the oats overnight in the refrigerator and eat them cold.

Pan con tomate y jamón serrano.t: Bread with tomato and serrano ham
Pan con tomate y jamón serrano.s: Toast the bread and rub it lightly with the garlic. Grate the tomato, drain it a little and spread it on the toast with a pinch of salt and the oil. Finish by covering with slices of freshly cut serrano ham.

Café con churros.s: Boil the water with the salt, remove from the heat and add the flour all at once; Stir vigorously until you obtain a smooth dough. Transfer the tempered dough to a piping bag with a crimped nozzle. Heat the oil to 180°C and fry strips of dough until golden brown, drain them on paper and roll them in sugar. Serve with freshly brewed coffee or hot chocolate.

Gazpacho andaluz.s: Chop the tomatoes, peeled cucumber, pepper and garlic and blend them with the soaked bread, vinegar and salt for 2 minutes. With the mixer running, add the oil little by little so that it emulsifies and adjust the thickness with the cold water. Pass through a fine sieve if you want it silkier and refrigerate for at least 2 hours. Serve very cold with croutons or chopped vegetables on top.

Cocido madrileño.s: Soak the chickpeas the day before with warm water and salt. In a large pot with cold water, place the blood sausage, chicken, bacon and ham bone; Bring to a boil and foam well. Add the chickpeas in a net and cook over low heat for about 2 hours (45 minutes in a pressure cooker). Add the carrots and potatoes and cook for 30 more minutes; Meanwhile, cook the cabbage with the chorizo ​​separately. Strain part of the broth and cook the noodles in it for 3 minutes. Serve in three batches: first the soup, then the chickpeas with the vegetables and finally the chopped meats.

Tortilla francesa con ensalada.s: Beat the eggs with a pinch of salt without foaming. Heat a non-stick frying pan with a few drops of oil, pour in the egg and, with medium heat, fold the tortilla in on itself before it sets completely so that it remains juicy. Serve with lettuce, tomato and chives seasoned with oil, vinegar and salt.

Croquetas de jamón.s: Melt the butter and sauté the finely chopped onion with the diced ham for 3 minutes. Add the flour and cook for 2 minutes without coloring; Pour in the hot milk little by little, stirring, and cook the bechamel for 15-20 minutes over low heat until it comes away from the pan. Season with nutmeg, spread on a plate and chill in the refrigerator for at least 4 hours. Form the croquettes, dip them in beaten egg and breadcrumbs and fry them in very hot oil until golden brown. Serve with fresh salad.

Tostada de aguacate y huevo.s: For the poached eggs, boil water with the vinegar, create a whirlpool and set each egg for 3 minutes; You can also cook them for 10 minutes if you prefer them hard. Mash the avocado with lemon juice, salt and pepper. Toast the bread, spread the avocado cream and top each toast with an egg.

Yogur griego con miel y nueces.t: Greek yogurt with honey and walnuts
Yogur griego con miel y nueces.s: Divide the Greek yogurt between two bowls. Chop the walnuts and toast them for 2 minutes in a pan without oil to enhance their flavor. Spread the walnuts over the yogurt, drizzle with honey and finish with a pinch of cinnamon.

Magdalenas caseras con café.s: Beat the eggs with the sugar until they whiten and double in volume. Add the oil, milk and zest and mix; Incorporate the sifted flour with the yeast with gentle movements. Rest the dough for 30 minutes in the refrigerator, fill the molds 3/4 full and bake at 210 °C, dropping to 190 °C for about 14-16 minutes until they rise fully. Accompany with hot coffee with milk.

Ensalada de quinoa y aguacate.s: Wash the quinoa under the tap and cook it in twice as much salted water for 15 minutes until the grain opens; drain it and let it cool. Mix in a salad bowl with the chopped cherries, the diced cucumber, the finely chopped onion and the chopped avocado. Dress with lemon, oil, salt and chopped parsley just before serving.

Fabada asturiana.s: Soak the beans in cold water the day before and desalt the lacón if needed. Cook them covered in cold water with the compango (chorizo, blood sausage, bacon and pork belly), the onion, the bay leaf and the oil; When it boils, foam and reduce the heat to minimum. Cook for 2-3 hours with the pot barely bubbling, shaking the beans with cold water two or three times and moving the pot back and forth without stirring with a spoon so they don't break. Add the saffron at the end, adjust the salt and let it rest for half an hour; Serve the beans with the chopped compango.

Merluza a la plancha con verduras.s: Sauté the zucchini in half moons, the pepper in strips and the chopped asparagus with a tablespoon of oil and the minced garlic for 6-8 minutes; They should be al dente. Dry the hake loins well, season with salt and pepper and grill them very hot with the rest of the oil for 3 minutes on the skin side and 2 on the other. Serve the hake over the vegetables with a squeeze of lemon and chopped parsley.

Pulpo a la gallega.s: Cook whole potatoes with skin on in salted water for 20-25 minutes; Peel them and cut them into thick slices (cachelos). Temper the octopus in the same water for 2 minutes and cut it into slices with scissors. Assemble the plate with the bed of cachelos and the octopus on top, sprinkle the two paprikas and the coarse salt and drizzle generously with the raw olive oil.

Porridge de avena con plátano.s: Put the oats with the almond milk in a saucepan and cook over low heat for 5-7 minutes, stirring until thickened and creamy. Remove from heat and mix in chia seeds. Serve with sliced ​​banana, cinnamon and a drizzle of honey on top.

Smoothie tropical de mango.s: Peel and chop the mango and banana (if you freeze them before, the smoothie will be like a sorbet). Blend with the coconut milk and lime juice for 1 minute until silky. Divide into two glasses, add the chia seeds, stir and let sit for 5 minutes to hydrate.

Bocadillo de tortilla.s: Cut the potato into thin slices and sauté it with the onion in the oil over medium heat for 15 minutes; drain well. Mix with the beaten eggs and salt and set a juicy tortilla, 2-3 minutes per side. Open the baguette, fill it with the freshly made tortilla and cut it into two sandwiches.

Pisto manchego con huevo.s: Sauté the diced onion and peppers in the oil for 10 minutes over medium heat. Add the diced zucchini and sauté for 10 more minutes. Add the crushed tomato with a pinch of sugar and salt and cook uncovered for 20 minutes, stirring, until the water evaporates and the ratatouille is melty. Top with grilled or poached eggs on top of the ratatouille, covering for 3 minutes.

Arroz a la cubana.s: Sauté the whole garlic in a tablespoon of oil, add the rice, give it a stir and cook with twice as much water and salt for 12 minutes; let it rest covered. Fry the banana cut lengthwise until golden. Fry the eggs in very hot oil with a frying pan. Unmold the rice with a cup, sauce it with the hot fried tomato and accompany it with the egg and banana.

Crema de calabaza con jengibre.s: Sauté the chopped onion and leek in the oil for 5 minutes without letting them color. Add the diced pumpkin and grated ginger, sauté for 2 minutes and cover with the broth. Cook for 20 minutes until the pumpkin is tender and blend until you obtain a fine cream; Adjust salt and thickness with more broth if necessary. Serve with the toasted seeds on top.

Sepia a la plancha con alioli.s: Dry the cuttlefish very well and make some superficial grid cuts on the inside so that it does not shrink. Very hot griddle or frying pan with oil: cook the cuttlefish for 2-3 minutes on each side until golden and tender. Mix the chopped garlic and parsley and spread them on top with a squeeze of lemon; Serve with the aioli separately.

Tostada con queso fresco y mermelada.t: Toast with fresh cheese and jam
Tostada con queso fresco y mermelada.s: Toast the bread until crispy. Cut the fresh cheese into thick slices and spread it over the toast. Cover with a thin layer of jam and finish with some chopped walnuts for a crunchy touch.

Bowl de yogur y granola.s: Divide the yogurt into two cold bowls. Chop the seasonal fruit (banana, strawberries, kiwi or whatever you have) and place it on top. Add the granola at the last minute so it doesn't get soft and finish with a drizzle of honey.

Churros con chocolate.s: Boil the water with the salt, add the flour all at once off the heat and stir until you achieve a smooth dough; transfer it to a piping bag with a curly nozzle. Fry strips of dough in oil at 180°C until golden brown, drain and coat in sugar. For the chocolate, heat the milk with the dissolved cornstarch, add the chopped chocolate and stir over low heat until it thickens. Serve the freshly made churros with the hot chocolate.

Salmón a la plancha con espárragos.s: Take the salmon out of the refrigerator 15 minutes beforehand and dry it well. Hot grill with a tablespoon of oil: cook the loins for 4 minutes on the skin side and 2 on the other, seasoning with salt and pepper; They should be juicy inside. Sauté the asparagus on the same grill for 5 minutes. Serve with the dressed lettuce, lemon and dill on top.

Macarrones con chorizo.s: Sauté the chopped onion and garlic in the oil, add the sliced chorizo and brown it for 3 minutes. Add the crushed tomato with a pinch of sugar and salt and cook for 15 minutes over low heat. Cook the macaroni in salted water for 1 minute less than what the package says, drain them and mix them with the sauce. Transfer to a bowl, cover with cheese and oregano and gratin for 5 minutes until bubbling.

Ensalada mediterránea con ventresca.s: Wash and chop the lettuce and cut the tomatoes into wedges. Assemble the salad with the onion in thin rings, the olives, the boiled egg in quarters and the belly crumbled into large flakes with its oil. Dress with the vinegar, a pinch of salt (a little, the belly already provides) and the olive oil at the last moment.

Albóndigas en salsa.s: Mix the meat with the breadcrumbs soaked in milk, the egg, chopped garlic and parsley, salt and pepper; form meatballs and flour them. Brown them in the oil in batches and set them aside. In the same oil, sauté the chopped onion for 8 minutes, add the tomato and cook for 10 minutes; blend the sauce if you want it fine. Return the meatballs to the sauce with the broth and cook, covered, over low heat for 15 minutes. Serve with white rice or potatoes.

Tostada integral con aguacate.s: Mash the avocado with a fork along with the lemon juice and a pinch of salt, leaving some pieces whole. Toast the bread and spread the avocado cream generously. Top with chopped cherry tomatoes, flaked salt and a drizzle of olive oil.

Zumo de naranja natural.s: Juice the oranges and serve freshly to preserve the vitamin C. Sweeten with honey only if needed.
Zumo de naranja natural.b: The vitamin C in oranges contributes to defenses and reduces fatigue.

Tortitas con fruta y miel.s: Mix the flour with the yeast and salt; Separately, beat the egg with the milk and melted butter and combine the two without overworking the dough. Let it rest for 10 minutes. Cook the pancakes in a non-stick pan over medium heat: pour in a ladle, wait for bubbles to appear and turn for 1 more minute. Stack with the chopped fruit and honey on top.

Ensalada templada de garbanzos.s: Sauté the pepper in strips with a tablespoon of oil for 5 minutes, add the sliced garlic and, when it smells, the spinach until it softens. Add the drained chickpeas, paprika and cumin and sauté for 3-4 minutes to soften and take on flavor. Turn off, season with vinegar and the rest of the oil and serve warm.

Paella de marisco.s: Open the steamed mussels and reserve their strained water along with the broth. Mark the shrimp in the paella with the oil and set them aside; Sauté the squid in rings for 3 minutes, add the garlic, tomato and paprika and cook for 2 minutes. Add the rice, give it a stir, pour in the hot broth with the saffron and cook for 10 minutes over high heat and 7 over low heat without stirring. Place the prawns and mussels on top, rest for 5 minutes covered with a cloth and serve with lemon.

Pimientos rellenos de bacalao.s: Sauté half a chopped onion, add the crumbled cod and give it a stir. Add the flour, cook for 1 minute and pour in the milk little by little until you obtain a thick bechamel with the cod; let it cool. Fill the piquillos with the mixture, place them in a bowl, season them with the crushed tomato sautéed with the rest of the onion and bake for 15 minutes at 180°C.

Hamburguesa casera con patatas.s: Cut the potatoes into sticks, dry them, mix them with a tablespoon of oil and salt and bake them at 200°C for about 30 minutes, turning them halfway. Lightly knead the meat with salt and pepper and form two burgers without pressing them together. Grill them for 3 minutes per side, putting the cheese on top at the end so that it melts. Assemble the toasted bread with lettuce, tomato, onion and meat, and serve with the potatoes.

Huevos revueltos con champiñones.s: Slice the mushrooms and sauté them over high heat until they lose their water and turn golden brown. Lower the heat, add the butter and eggs barely beaten with salt and stir constantly with a spatula, removing the pan from the heat at times, until they set into creamy lumps. Serve immediately with chopped chives and pepper.

Batido de frutos rojos.s: Put the berries (fresh or frozen) in the blender with the yogurt, milk and honey. Blend for 1 minute until smooth and creamy; with frozen fruit it will have a sorbet texture. Serve cold, freshly made.

Tostada francesa (torrija).s: Heat the milk with half the sugar and let it cool. Soak the bread slices well in the milk and then dip them in the beaten egg. Brown them in a pan with the butter for 2 minutes on each side and coat them in the mixture of the rest of the sugar and cinnamon. Serve them warm.

Bowl de quinoa, pollo y verduras.s: Wash and cook the quinoa in twice as much salted water for 15 minutes; drain and reserve. Season the breast with salt and pepper, spread it with cumin and a tablespoon of oil and grill it for 4-5 minutes per side; let it rest and cut it into strips. Sauté the zucchini in half moons for 4 minutes. Assemble the bowls with the quinoa base, the chicken, the zucchini, the cherry blossoms and the avocado, and season with lemon and the rest of the oil.

Cordero asado con patatas.s: Take the lamb out of the refrigerator 1 hour beforehand and preheat the oven to 180°C. Spread the shoulder with oil, salt and crushed garlic and place it on a bed of thickly sliced ​​potatoes with the rosemary. Pour the wine and water into the pan and roast for 60-75 minutes, turning halfway through and tossing with the juice every 20 minutes; If it remains dry, add a little more water. It should be golden on the outside and tender to the bone; Let rest 10 minutes before serving.

Crema de verduras de temporada.s: Sauté the sliced leek in the oil for 3 minutes. Add the chopped carrot, potato and zucchini, sauté for 5 minutes and cover with the broth. Cook for 20-25 minutes until everything is tender and blend until you achieve a fine cream; salt and pepper Serve with a drizzle of raw oil or some croutons.

Tosta de salmón ahumado.s: Toast the bread until crispy and let it cool for a minute. Spread a generous layer of cream cheese and spread the smoked salmon in waves. Finish with capers, dill and a squeeze of lemon with a touch of freshly ground pepper.

Jugo de remolacha y jengibre.s: Chop the beet, blend with the ginger and mix with the orange juice and water. Strain and serve cold.
Jugo de remolacha y jengibre.b: The nitrates in beets improve circulation and support the liver's function in purification.

Batido Verde Detox.s: Wash the spinach, chop the pineapple and beat everything with the coconut water, ginger and lemon for 1 minute.
Batido Verde Detox.b: The chlorophyll in spinach and bromelain in pineapple support liver cleansing and digestion.

Smoothie de cúrcuma dorada.s: Peel and chop the mango and beat with the coconut milk, turmeric, pepper and honey until silky.
Smoothie de cúrcuma dorada.b: Tropical version of 'golden milk': anti-inflammatory turmeric with vitamin A from mango and healthy fats from coconut.

Smoothie de frutos rojos.s: Beat the red berries with the yogurt, milk and honey. With frozen fruit it is like a creamy sorbet.
Smoothie de frutos rojos.b: The anthocyanins in red fruits have anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects; Yogurt provides probiotics for the flora.

Agua infusionada menta.s: Mix the cucumber, mint and lemon in a jug with cold water and let sit for 1 hour. Serve with ice.
Agua infusionada menta.b: Cucumber hydrates with very few calories and mint calms the stomach and facilitates digestion.

Jugo verde depurativo.s: Wash and chop everything and blend or grind with water. Strain and drink immediately.
Jugo verde depurativo.b: Celery and parsley have a natural diuretic effect that helps eliminate retained fluids and purify the body.

i: 300 ml of milk or vegetable drink
Batido de avena y canela.s: Beat the oats with the chopped apple, milk, cinnamon and honey for 1 minute. Let it rest for 5 minutes to thicken.
Batido de avena y canela.b: The beta-glucan fiber in oats regulates transit and satiates; Cinnamon helps control blood sugar.

Jugo de manzana verde.s: Chop the apples and blend with the ginger, water and lemon. Drink freshly to take advantage of the enzymes.
Jugo de manzana verde.b: The green apple is rich in fiber and low in sugar; With ginger it promotes light digestion.

Smoothie antiinflamatorio.s: Beat everything for 1 minute. The pinch of pepper is not noticeable but it multiplies the absorption of turmeric.
Smoothie antiinflamatorio.b: Curcumin from turmeric is one of the most studied natural anti-inflammatories; With fat and pepper it is absorbed much better.

Smoothie de pepino y menta.s: Blend the cucumber with mint, lemon, yogurt and water until smooth and refreshing. Serve very cold.
Smoothie de pepino y menta.b: Cucumber hydrates and refreshes and mint calms the stomach: ideal after heavy meals.

Agua de limón detox.s: Squeeze the lemon into the warm water, add the grated ginger and honey and stir well. Take it on an empty stomach to activate the liver and digestion.
Agua de limón detox.b: Lemon on an empty stomach stimulates the production of bile and provides vitamin C; Ginger helps digestion and honey softens the flavor.

Jugo de granada y moras.s: Mash the pomegranate and blackberries with the water and lemon and strain to remove the seeds. Serve cold.
Jugo de granada y moras.b: Very rich combination of antioxidant polyphenols that help protect the heart and combat cellular aging.

i: 200 ml of water or vegetable milk
Batido de pera y manzana.s: Peel and chop the pear and apple and beat with the water, honey and lemon until smooth.
Batido de pera y manzana.b: Pear and apple provide soluble fiber (pectin) that takes care of the intestinal flora and softens digestion.

Jugo cítrico energético.s: Squeeze the oranges and lemon, add the grated ginger and honey and stir. Have it freshly made in the morning.
Jugo cítrico energético.b: Triple contribution of vitamin C that reduces fatigue, with ginger that activates circulation and gives a boost of energy.

Jugo de kale y espinaca.s: Wash the leaves well, chop the apple and blend or blend everything with the water and lemon. Strain if you prefer it finer.
Jugo de kale y espinaca.b: Kale and spinach provide iron, folates and vitamins A, C and K that strengthen defenses and blood health.

Smoothie tropical premium.s: Beat the mango and banana with the coconut milk and lime for 1 minute. Add the chia, stir and let it rest for 5 minutes.
Smoothie tropical premium.b: Mango and banana provide energy and potassium and chia adds fiber and omega-3 for a complete boost.

Jugo de zanahoria.s: Blend the carrots and mix with the orange juice. Add ginger if you want a spicy touch. Serve cold.
Jugo de zanahoria.b: The beta-carotene in the carrot is converted into vitamin A (eye and skin) and the orange provides energy and vitamin C.

Jugo antioxidante.s: Blend the blueberries and pomegranate with the water and lemon and strain. Freshly made baby.
Jugo antioxidante.b: Blueberries and pomegranate are among the fruits with the most anthocyanins, antioxidants that protect cells and the heart.

i: 1 tablespoon of protein or almond cream
250 ml of milk or almond drink
Smoothie de recuperación.s: Beat the banana with the protein (or almond cream), milk and ice until creamy. Take it after training.
Smoothie de recuperación.b: Protein to repair muscle and potassium from banana to replace salts lost after exercise.

Agua infusionada limón.s: Put the lemon slices and ginger in a jug with the water and let it infuse for 2 hours in the refrigerator. Drink throughout the day.
Agua infusionada limón.b: A gentle way to hydrate with extra vitamin C and antioxidants that promote liver purification.

Batido de coco y jengibre.s: Beat the coconut milk with the banana, peeled ginger and cinnamon until creamy. Serve with ice.
Batido de coco y jengibre.b: Ginger and cinnamon have an anti-inflammatory effect and coconut fats provide stable energy.

Zumo verde detox.s: Wash everything, chop and blend or grind with water. Strain if you prefer it finer and drink immediately.
Zumo verde detox.b: Celery, cucumber and apple provide water, fiber and minerals that help purify.

Zumo de zanahoria, naranja y jengibre.s: Blend the carrots with the peeled ginger and mix with the orange juice. Stir and serve cold.
Zumo de zanahoria, naranja y jengibre.b: The beta-carotene in carrots takes care of your eyesight and skin; ginger is anti-inflammatory.

Zumo de remolacha y manzana.s: Chop the beet and apples, blend with the water and lemon and strain. Ideal one hour before training.
Zumo de remolacha y manzana.b: The natural nitrates in beets promote circulation and sports performance.

Zumo de granada.s: Shell the pomegranates and pass the grains through the juicer or crush and strain. Freshly made baby.
Zumo de granada.b: The pomegranate is one of the fruits with the most antioxidants; helps take care of the heart.

Zumo de piña y pepino.s: Blend the pineapple and cucumber with the water, strain and serve with chopped mint on top.
Zumo de piña y pepino.b: The bromelain in the pineapple helps digestion and the cucumber hydrates with very few calories.

Zumo de sandía y lima.s: Mash the watermelon with the lime juice, strain if you want and serve very cold with the mint.
Zumo de sandía y lima.b: Watermelon is 92% water and provides potassium: perfect for replenishing after heat or exercise.

Limonada casera con menta.s: Squeeze the lemons, mix with the water and honey until dissolved and serve with ice and mint.
Limonada casera con menta.b: Refreshes, hydrates and provides vitamin C without the sugars of soft drinks.

Zumo de pomelo y naranja.s: Squeeze the citrus, mix and sweeten slightly if the grapefruit is too bitter for you.
Zumo de pomelo y naranja.b: Citrus fruits low in sugar and rich in vitamin C; The grapefruit is slightly purifying.

Zumo de uva negra.s: Wash the grapes well, crush the skin and strain. Serve cold without sweetening: the grape is already very sweet.
Zumo de uva negra.b: The polyphenols from the skin of black grapes (resveratrol) are cardioprotective antioxidants.

i: a pinch of salt and pepper
a few drops of hot sauce (optional)
Zumo de tomate especiado.s: Crush the tomatoes, strain, season with salt and pepper and add the lemon. Serve cold with the celery stick.
Zumo de tomate especiado.b: The lycopene in tomatoes is a powerful antioxidant and this juice has almost no calories.

i: 300 ml of milk or vegetable drink
Batido de fresa y plátano.s: Wash and chop the strawberries, peel the banana and beat everything with the milk until creamy.
Batido de fresa y plátano.b: Carbohydrates from the banana and vitamin C from the strawberry: quick energy before or after training.

i: 300 ml of milk or vegetable drink
Batido de avena y plátano.s: Beat everything for 1 minute and let it sit for 5 minutes so that the oats thicken. Ideal for breakfast.
Batido de avena y plátano.b: Oats provide beta-glucan fiber that satisfies and gives stable energy all morning.

Smoothie de espinacas y mango.s: Peel and chop the mango and banana, add the washed spinach and beat with the coconut water.
Smoothie de espinacas y mango.b: Iron and folates from spinach with vitamin A from mango: healthier skin and hair.

i: 200 g of red fruits (fresh or frozen)
Smoothie de frutos rojos y yogur.s: Beat everything until homogeneous. With frozen fruit it is like a creamy sorbet.
Smoothie de frutos rojos y yogur.b: Antioxidant anthocyanins from red fruits and probiotics from yogurt for intestinal flora.

Batido de chocolate, plátano y cacahuete.s: Beat all the ingredients until creamy. Perfect after training.
Batido de chocolate, plátano y cacahuete.b: Peanut and milk protein with banana carbohydrates: muscle recovery.

Smoothie de aguacate y cacao.s: Beat everything well until there are no lumps. It looks like a chocolate dessert, but it's pure fruit.
Smoothie de aguacate y cacao.b: Healthy fats from avocado and magnesium from pure cocoa: creamy, satisfying and heart-healthy.

Lassi de mango.s: Beat the peeled mango with the yogurt, milk and honey. Serve cold with cardamom on top.
Lassi de mango.b: Indian yogurt drink: probiotics for digestion and calcium for bones.

Batido de papaya y naranja.s: Peel the papaya, remove the seeds and blend with the juice and yogurt. Serve with ice.
Batido de papaya y naranja.b: The papain in papaya facilitates the digestion of proteins and its vitamin A takes care of the skin.

Smoothie de kiwi, pepino y manzana.s: Blend everything together until fine. Don't strain it: the fiber in kiwi is part of the benefit.
Smoothie de kiwi, pepino y manzana.b: Kiwi has more vitamin C than orange and fiber that regulates intestinal transit.

Batido dorado de cúrcuma y mango.s: Beat everything for 1 minute. The pinch of pepper is not noticeable and multiplies the effect of turmeric.
Batido dorado de cúrcuma y mango.b: Curcumin is anti-inflammatory; with black pepper and dairy fat it is absorbed much better.

Batido de melocotón y yogur.s: Peel the peaches and beat with the rest. In winter it works the same with peaches in their juice (drained).
Batido de melocotón y yogur.b: Vitamin A from peaches for the skin and calcium + protein from yogurt for bones.

Batido de café y plátano.s: Shake everything with ice and serve immediately. Replaces mid-morning coffee with sugar.
Batido de café y plátano.b: Natural caffeine and carbohydrates from banana: the perfect boost to start the day.

Piña colada sin alcohol.s: Beat the pineapple with the coconut milk, juice and ice until foamy. Serve very cold.
Piña colada sin alcohol.b: Healthy version of the classic: hydrates and provides digestive bromelain from pineapple.

Smoothie de arándanos y avena.s: Beat everything and let it rest for 5 minutes. With frozen blueberries it is even creamier.
Smoothie de arándanos y avena.b: Blueberries protect memory and eyesight; oatmeal keeps hunger at bay.

Ayran de pepino y menta.s: Beat the yogurt with the water and salt, add the grated cucumber and chopped mint and serve with ice.
Ayran de pepino y menta.b: Turkish salty yogurt drink: replenishes salts and refreshes better than any soft drink in summer.

Batido de dátiles y almendras.s: Soak the dates in hot water for 10 minutes, drain and blend with the rest until smooth.
Batido de dátiles y almendras.b: Slowly absorbed natural sugars from the date and calcium from the almonds.

Zumo antigripal de cítricos y jengibre.s: Squeeze the citrus, grate the ginger and mix everything with the honey. Have it freshly made.
Zumo antigripal de cítricos y jengibre.b: Triple dose of vitamin C with ginger and honey: the classic winter tonic.

Iaurt cu nuci și miere.s: Divide the yogurt into two cold bowls. Break the walnuts into pieces and brown them for 2 minutes in a dry pan to intensify their flavor. Sprinkle the nuts over the yogurt, add the honey in a thin thread and finish with a pinch of cinnamon.

Omletă cu brânză și roșii.s: Dice the tomato and leave it for 5 minutes in a sieve to drain. Beat the eggs with pepper and very little salt (the telemeau is salty). Heat the butter over medium heat, pour in the eggs and, when they start to set, sprinkle the crumbled cheese, tomato and green onion. Fold the omelette in half and leave it for another 1 minute, so that it remains creamy in the middle.

Ciorbă de burtă.s: Wash the belly well and boil it with the bone, carrots, celery and bay leaves in salted water for about 3 hours (or 1 hour in the pressure cooker), foaming often. Remove the belly and cut it into thin strips; strain the juice and put the strips back. Beat the cream with the yolks, thin with a few drops of warm juice and pour into the soup taken off the heat, stirring. Add the crushed garlic rubbed with vinegar, season with salt and serve hot, with hot pepper to taste.

Sarmale cu mămăligă.s: Saute the chopped onion, mix it with the meat, raw rice, thyme, salt and pepper. Unroll the cabbage leaves, cut off the thick spine and wrap in small, tight strips. Put them in the pot on a bed of chopped cabbage, with the ribs and bay leaves in between, cover with water and stock and cook on low heat for 2-3 hours, until it reduces. For the polenta, boil the water with salt, pour the oil into the rain and mix for 25 minutes. Serve hot sarmales with polenta and cream.

Salată de boeuf.s: Boil potatoes and carrots in their skins until tender but firm; let them cool completely. Cut vegetables, boiled meat and well-drained pickles into small cubes. Mix everything with the peas, mayonnaise and mustard and season with salt and pepper. Refrigerate the salad at least an hour before serving and garnish with mayonnaise and pickles on top.

i: Mixed minced meat of beef and pork
Mici cu muștar.s: Mash the garlic with a little salt and mix it with the cold soup as a thin slurry. Knead the minced meat well with the baking soda, thyme, paprika, salt, pepper and strained mustard, 8-10 minutes, until it becomes sticky like a paste. Cover and leave the composition in the refrigerator for at least 3 hours, ideally overnight, so that the flavors bind. With wet hands, form small ones of about 8 cm and keep them for 20 minutes at room temperature. Heat the grill or a grill pan well and fry the little ones for 4-5 minutes on each side, turning them often with tongs, without pricking them, until they have a golden crust. Serve immediately, with plenty of mustard and bread.

Brânză proaspătă cu ridichi.s: Mix the fresh cheese with finely chopped green onions and a little salt. Wash the radishes and cut them into thin slices. Serve the cheese on fresh or toasted whole grain bread, topped with radish slices and freshly ground pepper.

Smoothie cu spanac și măr.s: Wash the spinach well and cut the apple into pieces, without the spine. Put all the ingredients in the blender and blend for 1 minute, until it becomes completely creamy, without lumps. Serve immediately, cold, to preserve the vivid color and vitamins.

Ciorbă de fasole cu afumătură.s: Soak the beans in the evening. Boil the smoked chickpeas for 1 hour, then add the drained beans and boil them together until soft. Add the chopped carrot, onion, celery and pepper and cook for another 20 minutes. Put the broth and boiled borscht separately, let it boil a few times and season with salt. At the end, add the thyme and chopped lavender; serve with the meat from the meat cut into pieces.

Tochitură moldovenească.s: Cut the meat into cubes and brown it in lard or oil over high heat; add the sausages in the rounds and saute for another 5 minutes. Deglaze with the wine, add the broth, crushed garlic and thyme and let it simmer for 20 minutes, until the sauce thickens. In the meantime, make the polenta: water with salt, millet in the rain, mixed for 25 minutes. Serve the tochitura next to the polenta, with grated cheese on top and a poached egg on top.

Chifteluțe de pui la cuptor.s: Mix the chopped chicken with the grated and well-squeezed onion, the crushed garlic, the egg, the breadcrumbs and the parsley; season with salt and pepper. Form meatballs with wet hands and place them on a tray lined with baking paper, greased with oil. Bake them at 200 °C for about 20-25 minutes, turning them halfway through, until they are golden brown. Good both hot and cold, with green salad.

Mâncare de praz cu măsline.s: Clean the leek and cut it into two finger rings; saute it in oil over medium heat until it softens and takes on a little color. Add the tomatoes, broth, bay leaf, sugar, salt and pepper and a glass of water. Boil covered over low heat for 20 minutes, add the olives and let the sauce reduce for another 10 minutes. It is served warm or cold, with bread.

Terci de ovăz cu fructe.s: Boil the oatmeal with the milk over low heat for 5-7 minutes, stirring often, until it thickens and becomes creamy. Pour into bowls and add the chopped fresh fruit (bananas, berries, apple), thinly sliced ​​honey and cinnamon. In winter it is good hot, in summer you can leave it overnight in the fridge.

Papanași cu smântână.s: Mix the well-drained cottage cheese with the egg, sugar, semolina, lemon peel and baking soda, then gradually add the flour until you get a soft, slightly sticky dough. With floured hands, form two donuts with a hole in the middle and two balls. Fry them in hot oil on medium heat, 3-4 minutes on each side, until they are brown and penetrated. Serve the papanas warm with a dollop of cream and blueberry jam on top.

Iahnie de fasole.s: Soak the beans in the evening, then boil them in two waters (discard the first one after 10 minutes) with a bay leaf, until soft. Saute the chopped onion and carrot in oil, add the garlic, paprika and broth and extinguish with a ladleful of the bean juice. Pour the sauce over the drained beans, add the thyme and boil everything together for 15 minutes, to bind. Goes great with pickles or red onions.

Ardei umpluți.s: Cut the caps off the peppers and remove the seeds. Mix the meat with raw rice, seasoned onion, chopped greens, salt and pepper and stuff the peppers without crowding them. Put them in the pot with their mouths up, put the lids on, pour the broth diluted with enough water to cover them and the bay leaf. Cook over low heat, covered, for 45-50 minutes. Serve with sour cream and fresh dill.

Plachie de pește.s: Sauté the sliced onion in oil until golden, add the pepper and garlic and leave for another 3 minutes. Place half of the vegetables in a tray, place the salted and peppered fish on top and cover with the rest of the vegetables and the sliced ​​tomatoes. Pour the wine, add the bay leaf and bake at 180 °C for about 25-30 minutes, until the fish falls apart. Serve with lemon and chopped parsley.

Zacuscă cu pâine.s: Bake the eggplants and peppers on the flame or in the oven until soft, clean them and chop them finely. Sauté the chopped onion in oil, add the eggplant, peppers, stock, bay leaf, salt and pepper and cook over low heat for 30 minutes, stirring often to prevent sticking. Let it cool and spread it on fresh or toasted bread; it's equally good hot or cold.

Ouă ochiuri cu mămăligă.s: Boil water with salt, pour the sorghum in the rain and mix on low heat for 20-25 minutes, until the sorghum comes off the walls. Fry the eggs in butter over medium heat, with the white set and the yolk soft. Place the hot polenta in plates, place the eggs on top and sprinkle the grated cheese so that it melts from the heat.

Clătite cu gem.s: Beat the eggs with the sugar, salt and vanilla, add the milk and then the flour, mixing until there are no more lumps; the dough should be thin, like liquid cream. Let it rest for 15 minutes. Grease a non-stick pan with a little butter and cook thin pancakes, 1 minute on one side and 30 seconds on the other. Fill them with jam, roll them up and serve them warm.

Ciorbă de perișoare.s: Boil the finely chopped vegetables in 2 liters of salted water for 15 minutes. In the meantime, mix the meat with the raw rice, the egg, a grated onion, salt and pepper and form small patties with wet hands. Place them one by one in the boiling stock and simmer for 25 minutes, foaming. Add the broth and the separately cooked borscht, give it a few more boils and finish with plenty of chopped pine nuts.

Pilaf cu legume.s: Saute the chopped onion with the diced carrot and pepper in oil for 5 minutes. Add the washed rice and stir for 2 minutes to coat in the oil. Pour in the hot soup, add the peas, salt and pepper, cover and simmer for 15 minutes without stirring. Leave the pilaf covered for another 10 minutes, fluff it with a fork and sprinkle with chopped parsley.

Salată de vinete.s: Bake the eggplants on the flame or on the grill, turning them, until they are completely soft and the skin is evenly charred. Clean them, let them drain in a sieve for 30 minutes, then chop them with a wooden or ceramic knife. Mix the paste with the oil poured in gradually, like mayonnaise, add finely chopped onion and salt. Serve cold with slices of tomato and fresh bread.

Pui cu ciuperci.s: Cut the chicken into cubes, salt it and brown it in oil over high heat for 5 minutes; put it aside. In the same pan, saute the onion, then the sliced ​​mushrooms until the remaining water is reduced. Put the chicken back, add the crushed garlic and the cream, mix and cook on low heat for 10 minutes, until the sauce thickens slightly. Finish with chopped dill; it goes perfectly with polenta or rice.

Tartine cu brânză și legume.s: Mix the fresh cheese with the chopped dill, salt and pepper until it becomes creamy. Spread on slices of fresh or toasted bread. Cover with thin slices of cucumber, tomato and radish and finish with freshly ground pepper and a little more dill.

Smoothie cu banane și ovăz.s: Put the oatmeal in the blender and grind for 10 seconds. Add the chopped bananas, milk, honey and cinnamon and mix for 1 minute until creamy. Let the oats hydrate for 5 minutes and serve; it's a breakfast that keeps you hungry all morning.

Ghiveci de legume.s: Cut all the vegetables into suitable pieces and place them in a large tray. Mix them with the oil, sliced ​​garlic, thyme, salt and pepper. Bake at 190 °C for about 50 minutes, stirring every 20 minutes, until the vegetables are tender and slightly caramelized at the edges. Sprinkle with chopped parsley; good warm or cold, with bread.

Friptură de porc cu cartofi.s: Rub the neck slices with salt, pepper, paprika, thyme and crushed garlic and leave them to marinate for at least 30 minutes. Place them in the tray over the quartered potatoes and mix with oil and salt, pour the wine and cover with foil. Bake at 190 °C for 30 minutes covered, then another 20 minutes uncovered, until the meat and potatoes are browned. Serve with pickles or salad.

Supă cremă de dovleac.s: Fry the onion in oil for 3 minutes, add the pumpkin, potato and diced carrot and mix for 2 minutes. Pour enough soup to cover the vegetables and cook for 20 minutes, until soft. Puree everything with the blender until smooth, season with salt and add the cream. Serve with toasted pumpkin seeds on top.

Salată de roșii cu brânză.s: Cut the tomatoes into generous slices and the cucumbers into rounds and arrange them on a plate. Add thinly sliced ​​red onion, olives and cubed or crumbled Telemea cheese. Drizzle with olive oil, sprinkle with herbs and pepper; I add the salt carefully, the telemeau is already salty.

Omletă cu ciuperci.s: Slice the mushrooms and saute them over high heat until all the water has evaporated and they are brown. Beat the eggs with salt and pepper, add the butter to the pan and pour the eggs over the mushrooms. Cook over medium heat, pulling the edges toward the center; sprinkle the cheese and green onions, fold the omelette and serve it while it is creamy.

Iaurt cu fructe de pădure.s: Divide the cold yogurt into two bowls. Add fresh or slowly thawed berries to the refrigerator, along with their juice. Finish with drizzled honey and ground flaxseed, which add omega-3s and fiber.

Ciorbă de legume.s: Sauté chopped onion, carrot and celery in oil for 5 minutes. Add 1.5 liters of water, diced potatoes, pepper and green beans and boil for 15 minutes. Add the chopped tomatoes and peas and cook for another 10 minutes, until the vegetables are tender. Add the separately cooked borscht, season with salt and serve with plenty of chopped leustean.

Mămăligă cu brânză și smântână.s: Boil water with salt, pour the cream in a drizzle, stirring with a whisk so that it does not form lumps, and cook on low heat for 25 minutes, stirring often. In a heat-resistant dish, put layers of polenta, grated cheese and butter, finishing with cheese. Put in the oven for 10 minutes at 180 °C, to melt the cheese, and serve hot with cream on top.

Pește la grătar cu salată.s: Brush the fish with a spoonful of oil, salt and pepper and leave it for 10 minutes. Heat the grill or grill pan well and fry the fish for 3-4 minutes on each side, without moving it, so that it comes off on its own. Prepare a light mujdei of garlic, lemon juice and the rest of the oil. Serve the fish sprinkled with mud, next to the green salad with cherry tomatoes and cucumbers.

Tocăniță de ciuperci.s: Saute the chopped onion in oil until it becomes glassy. Add the sliced ​​mushrooms and cook over high heat until the water left by them reduces. Put the crushed garlic, broth, thyme and half a glass of water and cook on low heat for 15 minutes, until the sauce thickens. Sprinkle with chopped dill and serve with polenta or bread.

Terci de quinoa cu scorțișoară.s: Rinse the quinoa under cold water to prevent it from becoming bitter. Boil it with the almond milk and cinnamon on low heat for 15 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the grains open and the porridge thickens. Add the grated apple and raisins, leave for another 2 minutes and serve warm, with honey on top.

Cozonac cu cafea.s: Cut generous slices of walnut or poppy seed cake; if it's more than a day old, heat them for 20 seconds in the oven or in a pan to regain their flavor. Prepare fresh coffee and heat milk. Serve the cozonac next to coffee with milk, sweetened to taste.

Sarmale de post.s: Saute the chopped onion with the grated carrot in oil, add the finely chopped mushrooms and cook until the water is reduced. Mix the filling with the raw rice, dill, thyme and pepper. Wrap small sausages in sauerkraut leaves and place them in the pot on a bed of chopped cabbage with bay leaves. Cover with water and broth and cook on low heat for 60-90 minutes, until the rice is soaked. With polenta they are even better.

Friptură de pui cu legume.s: Rub the thighs with salt, pepper, paprika, thyme and crushed garlic. Put the quartered potatoes, the carrot slices and the onion slices, mixed with oil and salt, in the tray and place the thighs on top, skin side up. Pour the soup, cover with foil and bake at 200 °C for 25 minutes; uncover and bake for another 20-25 minutes, until the skin is brown and crispy, and the vegetables are tender.

Salată orientală.s: Boil the potatoes in their skins for 20-25 minutes, until the fork easily enters them; also boil the hard-boiled eggs, 10 minutes. Peel and cut the potatoes into thick slices, quarter the eggs and thinly slice the red onion. Mix gently with the olives, sliced ​​pickles, oil, vinegar, salt and pepper. It's tastier after half an hour in the cold.

Supă de pui cu tăiței.s: Put the chicken in 2 liters of cold water with salt, bring to the boil and foam well. Add the whole onion, carrots, celery and parsnip and simmer for 50 minutes, until the meat falls off the bone. Strain the soup, put back the boneless meat and carrot slices and cook the noodles in the soup for 5 minutes. Serve hot with chopped green parsley.

Compot de mere.s: Cut the apples into slices, boil them in water with cinnamon for 15 minutes, sweeten them at the end and let them cool.
Compot de mere.b: Traditional light drink with fiber from apples and cinnamon to help with digestion and blood sugar balance.

Limonadă cu mentă.s: Mix lemon juice with water and honey, add lightly crushed mint and ice. Serve cold.
Limonadă cu mentă.b: Refreshing and hydrating, with vitamin C from lemon and stomach-soothing mint.

Suc de morcov.s: Squeeze the carrots and mix with the orange juice. Add ginger for extra flavor. Serve cold.
Suc de morcov.b: Rich source of beta-carotene (vitamin A) for vision and skin, with orange energy.

Ceai de tei.s: Infuse linden flowers in hot water for 7-10 minutes, covered. Strain and drink warm before bed.
Ceai de tei.b: Lime has a calming effect and helps with a peaceful sleep; it is also slightly sweaty when you have a cold.

Compot de prune.s: Boil whole plums in water with cinnamon for 15-20 minutes, sweeten and leave to cool.
Compot de prune.b: Plums are known for their mild laxative effect and the richness in fiber that regulates intestinal transit.

Suc verde.s: Wash the spinach, cut the apple and puree everything with water and lemon. Strain if you prefer smoother and drink immediately.
Suc verde.b: Chlorophyll from spinach and vitamin C from lemon help to detoxify the body and give a good dose of minerals.

Limonadă cu ghimbir.s: Mix the lemon juice with water, grated ginger and honey until dissolved. Serve with ice.
Limonadă cu ghimbir.b: Vitamin C in lemon and ginger activates circulation and gives energy without the sugar in fizzy drinks.

Compot de vișine.s: Boil the cherries in water for 10-15 minutes, sweeten to taste and cool well before serving.
Compot de vișine.b: Cherries are rich in anthocyanins, antioxidants that reduce inflammation and support sleep through natural melatonin.

Suc de sfeclă.s: Cut the beets and carrots, put them through a juicer or blender with water, add the lemon and strain.
Suc de sfeclă.b: Nitrates in beets improve circulation and support the liver in the detoxification process.

Ceai de mușețel.s: Scald chamomile flowers with hot water and leave covered for 5-7 minutes. Strain and drink warm, possibly with honey.
Ceai de mușețel.b: Chamomile soothes the stomach and reduces bloating; it is also slightly relaxing, suitable for the evening.

Suc de mere și morcov.s: Put the apples and carrots through the juicer or blender with the water, add the lemon and strain. Drink fresh.
Suc de mere și morcov.b: Beta-carotene in carrots and fiber in apples provide energy and support vision and skin.

Ceai de cătină.s: Crush the sea buckthorn, pour hot water (not boiling, so as not to destroy vitamin C) and let it infuse for 10 minutes. Strain and sweeten with honey.
Ceai de cătină.b: Sea buckthorn has several times more vitamin C than citrus fruits and strengthens immunity, especially in winter.
